binary = '/build/target/release/membershipd', nodes = 1

    @pytest.mark.parametrize('nodes', [1, 3])
    def test_each_compaction_request_completes_when_its_prefix_is_eligible(binary, nodes):
        """A newer stalled compaction cannot indefinitely block an older ready one."""
        ids = list(range(1, nodes + 1))
        c = Cluster(binary, ids=ids, voters=ids)
        try:
            c.elect(1)
            c.pause_apply.add(1)
            targets = []
            for i in range(4):
                c.write(1, f'compact-write-{i}', client=f'client-{i}', delta=i + 1)
                c.drain()
                c.event(1, 'compact')
                target = c.disks[1]['commit']
                generation = next(g for g, s in sorted(c.application[1].items()) if s['index'] >= target)
                targets.append((target, generation))
            for target, generation in targets:
                c.apply(1, generation)
                c.flush(1)

                    'eligible compaction waits for an unrelated later application job'
